summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall script that executes beacon.cjs, which POSTs host identifiers — hostname, install path, current working directory, Node.js version, and package name — to a hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon fires on require() through the main entry (index.js). The main module itself is a stub exporting a Proxy that returns no-op functions for any property access, and the package is published at version 99.0.1 under an org-looking scope with the description 'Compatibility shim.' — the shape of a dependency-confusion placeholder whose only purpose is to prove installation on internal build systems and report back to the operator.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
